name: Lefty Production Co.
old_description: ONE STOP SHOP APPAREL AND ACCESSORIES DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & PRODUCTION
about:
Lefty Production Co. operates from a suite on West 9th Street in downtown Los Angeles, California. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its principals describe learning the trade by producing collections in Asia and South America before returning to domestic manufacturing. The team is led by Marta Miller, a former apparel brand owner, and includes pattern makers and sewers with years of industry experience.

The firm functions as a one‑stop development house and contract manufacturer for apparel and accessories. Its service chain covers sourcing and design, pattern making, sample creation, duplicate samples, marking and grading, size testing, laser cutting, cutting and sewing, and final packing. Production runs range from small batches to larger volumes, with low minimums offered to clients who complete development through Lefty. All work is performed in their Los Angeles facility.

Clients span independent designers, established fashion labels, and major retailers. The company cites collaborations with high‑fashion names such as Matthew Williamson, Rosetta Getty, and Christian Siriano, as well as retail accounts including Nordstrom and Neiman Marcus. It has also produced official uniforms for NBC’s Spartan Ultimate Team Challenge and Netflix’s Ultimate Beastmaster, bomber jackets for the Guns N’ Roses Not in This Lifetime Tour, and the prize package for the Project Runway Junior Season 2 winner. Smaller brands like Touch of Terry, Swoveralls, and Major Blue are referenced in testimonials.

Lefty emphasizes a partnership model built on transparent, flat‑rate pricing and discounts tied to the number of designs. The company highlights its commitment to Made‑in‑USA production, decades of collective experience across global supply chains, and active engagement with fashion programs at FIDM, Cal Poly, and Santa Monica College. It was recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal in 2015.
